comments.value: As well as events that can fill up to fast when they're friends/+ but dies out when they're Invite/+ so the instance owner could change it depending on the flow of people.

I would be opposed to allowing instances to be upgraded, as it is useful to me that I can make guarantees about the privacy of a session I'm in and not have it change.
However, downgrading an instance seems reasonable.

details:
With the new additions of regions it would be cool, if you could upgrade instances from "Invite" up to "Friends+" and downgrade "Friends+" instances down to "Invite".
It would help when people are in their home world but want friend be able to join for example.
title: Ability to upgrade/downgrade instance types

voters.name: 【さわらないで】月夜野 晶
